description: This file defines a ViewComponent named 'Basket' used in an ASP.NET Core web application. The component handles displaying the number of items in a user's shopping basket, supporting both signed-in and anonymous users by checking cookies or user identity.

classes.name: Basket
classes.description: A ViewComponent responsible for rendering the shopping basket overview, including item count, for signed-in or anonymous users.

methods.name: InvokeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously constructs the view model with the total basket items and returns the view.

methods.name: CountTotalBasketItems
methods.description: Determines the total number of basket items for the current user, handling both signed-in and anonymous cases.

methods.name: GetAnnonymousIdFromCookie
methods.description: Retrieves the anonymous user ID from cookies, if available and valid.
